set.st: Israel Noel, an old man living alone in a little shack away from the traveled road near Fayette, was found dead on Monday 31 December 1900. His gold watch was missing and murder was suspected at first. Some days later the neighbours noticed freshly disturbed earth in his cellar, dug, and found the watch and $10,000 in gold. His son in the West was the heir. The find was reported across the county papers the same week. Pin is the village, not the house.
set.pl: Israel Noel's shack off the traveled road near Fayette, Lafayette County; lot not yet found (ring 3 km on the village)
set.t: Recovered 1901; the lesson is the cellar. Find the Noel shack on a c.1895-1900 Lafayette County plat or the 1900 census. Private land: ask first.
src: Shullsburg Southwestern Local, 4 Jan 1901, p. 1 (local report, first week)
